evidence.testName: module-root entries and installed package dependency closures remain available

assertions: Declared module roots and dependency closures remain semantically visible.

evidence.testName: project membership prunes inactive directories before enumeration or source reads

assertions: Undeclared ghost modules are excluded before semantic enumeration or reads.

evidence.testName: completion does not expose globals from an inactive target source directory

assertions: Inactive target globals never appear in active target completion.

evidence.testName: a watched target switch replaces membership and matches a fresh session

assertions: A watched target switch replaces membership and equals a fresh process result.

evidence.testName: an open workspace alias owns a relative import until the overlay closes

assertions: An open overlay is authoritative across path aliases until close restores disk truth.

evidence.testName: watched create delete and rename are visible to the immediately following semantic request

assertions: Watched create, delete, and rename are visible to the next semantic request.

evidence.testName: advances the catalog revision when a member identity changes

assertions: A changed member identity advances catalog generation without stale semantic reuse.
